title: Epoch sketchpad — compact experiment index
content:
Epoch sketchpad — compact experiment index (personal mini-sheet)
Owner: Luca Moreno — quick notes and running table for micro-bench experiments. Use as a light-weight ledger before moving results to the canonical eval harness.

TABLE (columns: date | run_id | model | quant | batch | seq_len | throughput_rps | p50_ms | p95_ms | cost_per_1k_tokens | notes)
2026-02-10 | e-2101 | rw/llama2-13b | q4_0 | 8 | 512  | 420  | 45  | 210 | $0.28 | prefix cache warmed; observed 3x p95 spike at ~t=3m (suspect GC or tail traffic)
2026-02-11 | e-2104 | rw/llama2-13b | fp16  | 1 | 1024 | 190  | 85  | 410 | $0.63 | single-stream baseline, stable CPU offload
2026-02-12 | e-2147 | rw/gpt-open-7b | q2_k | 16 | 256  | 1280 | 22  | 78  | $0.12 | excellent short prompt throughput; memory headroom low at peak
2026-02-13 | e-2159 | rw/llama2-13b | q4_0 | 4 | 768  | 310  | 50  | 240 | $0.33 | smaller batch reduced tail variance
2026-02-13 | e-2162 | rw/gpt-open-7b | q2_k | 32 | 128  | 2100 | 18  | 60  | $0.09 | best cost/latency for chat-style short seqs

QUICK CALC NOTES:
- cost_per_1k_tokens is a back-of-envelope using local instance-hour price and observed tokens/sec; treat as comparative, not absolute.
- throughput_rps measured steady-state after warmup (30s). p50/p95 from histogram sample.

PERSONAL TODO / CHECKLIST:
- [ ] Record model commit/hash for runs e-21xx (add column next pass)
- [ ] Re-run e-2101 with KV cache disabled to isolate p95 spikes (ticket INF-2987)
- [ ] Add seed + env variables (GPU driver build) into the run metadata
- [ ] Hook this mini-sheet to the eval harness: export CSV -> confluence/ENG-EVAL-142

NOTES TO SELF (scratch):
- Observed pattern: q4_0 better when long seq + cache warm. q2_k wins for short quick chat flows. That aligns with heuristic; quantify with 100-run sweep.
- p95 spikes seem correlated with background kernel updates on node pool A (check infra logs around 02/10 10:12 UTC).
- Consider a rolling 30-run median for p95 instead of single-run p95 to reduce noise.

IDEAS / SMALL EXPERIMENTS TO TRY NEXT:
- Canary: 50 runs switching quantization on the fly (q2_k <-> q4_0) to measure switch cost and transient tail behavior.
- Probe: disable prefetching + measure cold-cache latency curve (0s, 10s, 30s, 60s).
- Automation: lightweight tagger to mark runs as CHAT vs GENERATE based on avg seq_len, to group metrics automatically.

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- confluence:ENG-EVAL-142 (notes + official sweep plan)
- JIRA:INF-2987 (infra p95 spike investigation)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/224 (kernel selection tweak)

ONE-LINE SUMMARY:
Prefer q4_0 on 13b for long sequences when KV cache is warm; for short-chat throughput/cost prioritize q2_k on 7b. Use this sketchpad as quick capture; move validated sweeps to canonical harness.

End of scratchpad entry.
